scope: Expose bounded pre-output CLI diagnostics for explicit repair state, skipped DWG records, DXF text issue masks and the source $REQUIREDVERSIONS feature mask.

fields: sourceDxfTextIssueMask as a fixed-width 32-bit hexadecimal mask or not-applicable
sourceRequiredVersionsStatus and the exact 64-bit mask, plus output admission state
projection.limits: The diagnostic is bounded and read-only. It does not apply repairs or convert observations into a completeness/support claim.

runtimeInputs: A locally generated DXF with repeated $ACADVER HEADER structure is refused without changing its destination and is reported as repair-required.
A locally generated DXF with repeated group 10 inside $INSBASE is refused without changing its destination and is reported as repair-required.
A locally generated AC1021 DXF with $REQUIREDVERSIONS=1 targeting AC1024 exposes the exact mask and is refused atomically.
The same source targeting AC1032 exposes the mask as admitted, writes group 160 with value 1, and preserves it through typed DXF readback.
Locally generated duplicate-variable, repeated-group-160 and wrong-group-code $REQUIREDVERSIONS inputs report malformed/unknown, are refused at AC1032, and preserve source and destination bytes.
A locally authored AC1021 DXF text value reports the exact invalid-UTF-8/output mask 0x820 and exact-named codepage policy.
A locally authored malformed DXF Unicode escape reports the exact malformed/unrepresented escape mask and preserves source/destination bytes on refusal.
Locally authored AC1027 DWGs with one and three instances of the same unknown custom class report exact skipped-class/object totals; strict export preserves the destination.
control.sourceGenerator: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp --generate-cli-skip-source and --generate-cli-skip-source-multiple author one- and three-instance skipped-record DWGs from scratch at runtime.

validation.test: PASS: python3 tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter $PWD/build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer $PWD/build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --source-disposition-only (12 controls); PASS: same command with --fast-only (103 option controls, 47 batch controls, 2 read-observation controls, 18 partial-read controls, 12 source-disposition controls)

limits: HEADER diagnosis covers repeated-variable and repeated-group refusal only; the CLI did not repair any input, and broader caller/API repair workflows remain open.

Skip-count aggregation covers one and three instances of a single generated AC1027 custom class/unsupported-object category. Multiple class names, other skip/recovery categories and other revisions remain unqualified.

The $REQUIREDVERSIONS controls cover three malformed source shapes plus one valid mask preserved through AC1032 typed DXF output/readback and an AC1024 refusal. The mask's feature semantics, source-producer diversity and native acceptance remain open.

The DXF text mask is decoder-issue telemetry, not a unique count of corrupt records or a semantic loss total. Exact generated masks now cover invalid UTF-8/output (0x820) and malformed/unrepresented escapes (0x600); other decoder issue classes remain unqualified by this CLI selector.
